sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS NHANES public-use survey analysis tutorials plus public-use DEMO_J and Linked Mortality File

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS NHANES variance guidance says domain analyses should keep the design information for the full set of eligible non-zero-weight observations and use a subpopulation indicator rather than dropping records before variance estimation.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: Human Infra must not treat post-join subgroup filtering as a reviewed NHANES domain estimator.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS NHANES guidance names software mechanisms for domain or subpopulation analysis, including DOMAIN, SUBPOPX, Stata subpop(), and R survey-design subset() usage.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: A future estimator must choose and test a concrete software implementation path before weighted domain outputs are allowed.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS NHANES weighting guidance requires selecting weights that match the analytic scope and subpopulation represented by the analysis.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The public aggregate pilot cannot use a single grouped table as proof that every domain has a correct analysis weight and eligible base.

sourceFindings.observedFact: DEMO_J documents WTMEC2YR, SDMVPSU and SDMVSTRA, which are already captured by the upstream survey-design readiness contract.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: This contract starts after field presence: it only checks whether domain/subpopulation rules are ready for future estimator design.

readinessGates.evidence: CDC/NCHS variance tutorial documents DOMAIN, SUBPOPX, Stata subpop(), and R survey subset() mechanisms for domain/subpopulation analysis.
CDC/NCHS variance tutorial requires full eligible non-zero-weight design information to be retained for subpopulation variance estimation.
No Human Infra NHANES estimator currently constructs and reviews a domain indicator before design-based estimation.
The project has not selected R survey, Stata, SAS, SUDAAN or another reviewed estimator backend for NHANES domain outputs.
The public aggregate pilot does not yet materialize a non-persisted positive-weight eligible base before domain analysis.
No review exists for domain degrees-of-freedom, lonely PSU, empty domain or sparse-cell behavior.
No public-output disclosure review exists for design-weighted domain cells, rates, intervals or subgroup route summaries.
No calibrated prediction model, external validation, censoring model or competing-risk model uses NHANES domain estimates.

allowedUses: documentation of why subgroup row filtering is not a NHANES domain estimator
model-admission boundary test for future weighted estimator work
nextWork: Select a single estimator backend and implement a synthetic domain/subpopulation test before public outputs.
Build a non-row-persisting positive-weight eligible-base step before domain indicator evaluation.
Add domain degrees-of-freedom, sparse-cell and empty-domain synthetic cases.
Run disclosure review before any design-weighted public domain cell, interval or route summary.
